common.welcome:
👋 Hello, {name}!

I'm the CrossFit Hub bot. I'll help you manage your workout bookings.

Choose an action from the menu below:
common.help:
ℹ️ *CrossFit Hub Bot Help*

Use /start to begin.
common.help_athlete:
ℹ️ *Help — CrossFit Hub*

📅 *Schedule*
• Tap «Sign Up for a Workout» → choose a day
• Booking available for today and tomorrow only
• Maximum 2 bookings per day

📋 *My Bookings*
• View and cancel active bookings

📸 *Schedule Image*
• On the day selection screen, tap the image button

📝 *Restrictions*
• Booking open for the next 2 days only
• No more than 2 workouts per day
• Cancel anytime

Restart: /start
common.help_trainer:
ℹ️ *Help — CrossFit Hub (Trainer)*

📅 *Schedule Overview*
• Browse workouts for the next 7 days
• Tap your workout → «Manage Participants»
• Remove an athlete from your workout

🏋️ *My Workouts*
• Your assigned workouts for the week
• Remove athlete: tap «❌ Remove [name]»

📋 *Free Slots*
• Unassigned workouts for the next 7 days
• Tap «Assign Myself» to take a slot

Restart: /start
common.help_admin:
ℹ️ *Help — CrossFit Hub (Admin)*

👑 *Admin Panel (bot)*
• View schedule: today / tomorrow / week
• Assign trainer to a workout
• Delete workout (athletes get notified)
• Upload schedule image (📸)

🌐 *Web Interface*
• Create and edit workouts
• Bulk create from template
• Manage users and roles
• Edit schedule template

🏋️ *Trainer Panel (bot)*
• Schedule overview, manage your workouts
• Self-assign to free slots

Restart: /start
